resources.string: This version of Zenlygram is no longer supported. Update the app to continue.
To use Zenlygram with this account, we need your consent to keep its Telegram ID, phone number, name, usage statistics, subscription status and cloud tasks on our server in Tashkent.

Consent is optional. If you don\'t agree, no profile, statistics or cloud tasks are collected for this account and it is not linked automatically; the app keeps working on this device as before. You can agree later in Settings → Zenlygram → Data & consent.
This version of Zenlygram can\'t show the consent text. Update the app.
Couldn\'t save your choice. Try again.

No consent given. No profile, statistics or cloud tasks are collected for this account.
You declined. No profile, statistics or cloud tasks are collected for this account.
You withdrew consent on %1$s. Your data on our server is deleted no later than the next working day.

Delete my Zenlygram account and data
Data is stored on a server in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
This section applies only to this Telegram account.
The app keeps working on this device and sends no more profile, statistics or cloud tasks for this account.

This device isn\'t linked to our server, so your withdrawal can\'t be sent from here; it is sent if you link this device again. If you use this Telegram account in Zenlygram on another device, withdraw there too, or delete your data at zenlygram.org/account/delete, or write to the contact shown below.

This deletes your Zenlygram account and the data we hold for it: your profile, devices, statistics, cloud tasks, invitations and the account link. All devices linked to this account are signed out of Zenlygram.

Payment records are kept only as long as the law requires, with the details that identify you removed. A record that you gave and withdrew consent (account number, text versions and dates) is kept for 3 years.
Your Telegram account is not deleted.
Deletion starts at once and is completed no later than the next working day. Copies in encrypted backups and server logs disappear within 14 days.
This account isn\'t linked to the Zenlygram server from this device. To delete a Zenlygram account, open zenlygram.org/account/delete and sign in with Telegram.
This account isn\'t linked to the Zenlygram server from this device, so there is no server data to show.
If the update isn\'t offered for this device, it may need a newer Android version; Google Play may also show it with a delay.
Zenlygram %1$s is available on Google Play.

No signed server policy yet: Pro is free on this device.
Without this consent, Zenlygram can\'t be used with this Telegram account. Your other accounts are not affected.
The consent text has changed. Please read it and agree again.
Consent for this account was withdrawn on another device on %1$s.
This account\'s link to our server has ended (for example, its Zenlygram account was deleted). Zenlygram will not link it again by itself until you agree again.

Zenlygram keeps your subscription, cloud tasks and account data on its own server, and it needs your consent to do that. Without consent, Zenlygram can\'t be used with this Telegram account.\n\nYou can go back and read the consent again, delete your Zenlygram account and the data on our server, or log out of this account on this device. Logging out does not delete your Telegram account: it keeps working in other Telegram apps. This account\'s Zenlygram data that is stored only on this device (for example local tasks) may be removed when you log out.
Delete my Zenlygram account and data

This is the only account signed in on this device. Logging out also deletes this device\'s Zenlygram data: local tasks, the cloud task copy, call recordings, and the Secret Vault and Chat Lock settings.
After this, you can use Zenlygram with this account only after you agree again.
If the new version doesn\'t install on this device, it may need a newer Android version.
